candidates.name: htf_level_failed_break_d1w1
candidates.mechanism: False breakout of a D1/W1-scale horizontal extreme: D1 close beyond a long-lookback extreme traps breakout traders and triggers stops; failure to hold (close back inside within confirmation window) forces unwind, producing multi-day reversion toward the pre-break range. Same mechanism class as the surviving htf_false_breakout (1H SR false-break fade) generalized one-to-two timeframe levels up.

proposed_frozen_definition.level: rolling 55-trading-day Donchian extreme (prior quarter high/low), computed on D1 closes-excluded standard OHLC (level = max/min of prior 55 D1 highs/lows, excluding current bar). Rationale for 55d: quarter-scale institutional reference; single DoF, declared here, no variants.
proposed_frozen_definition.event: D1 close breaks beyond the level (close > prior 55d high, or close < prior 55d low), THEN within <=3 subsequent D1 bars a close back inside the level. Event bar = the re-close bar. Direction = fade (short after failed upside break, long after failed downside break).
proposed_frozen_definition.dedup: one event per side per 10 trading days (event-block).
proposed_frozen_definition.horizons_exit_free: {1d, 3d, 5d, 10d} forward from event-bar close; PRIMARY = 5d (single), others diagnostic.
proposed_frozen_definition.pairs: EUR_USD, USD_JPY, GBP_USD, AUD_USD, USD_CAD, EUR_JPY, AUD_JPY, NZD_USD (8; pooled primary like weekend_gap arm-B precedent, per-pair diagnostic)

candidates.expected_frequency: roughly 4-10 events/pair/year (to be asserted in explore; if <40 pooled events in explore window -> underpowered, declare before test)
candidates.headroom_estimate: D1 5d holds: typical |move| 40-120p vs RT 2.0-4.5p -> nominal 10-30x. Must be confirmed on event-conditional MFE p50 in explore BEFORE forward-return look (W3-2 precedent: headroom gate fwd-non-contact).
candidates.prior: medium-high (highest in this set): direct generalization of the only surviving 2-stage screen mechanism; postmortem success-shape 3/3 (low-freq, level-anchored, long hold).
candidates.banned_adjacency_and_differential: Ban (i) was H4 swing-pivot×touch-count wall levels with 15m holds, continuous scanning. Differential: (1) level generation = deterministic long-lookback extreme, not swing-pivot×touch; (2) hold = 1-10 D1 bars, not 15m; (3) low-frequency close-confirmed events, not per-bar scanning. Ban (iii) horizontal sweep&reclaim ×15m: that was WICK-penetration reclaim intraday; here breach must be a D1 CLOSE (not wick) and reversion horizon is days. MUST also declare relation to ledger #11 htf_fb recheck: proposed = separate family (different level TF, hold, and instrument set), with explicit cross-reference; verifier to confirm or overrule.
candidates.swap_accounting: 5-10d holds: net swap into EV using frozen per-pair swap estimates; declare in pre-reg.
candidates.known_risks: Donchian-extreme false breaks may cluster in trending regimes (event-block bootstrap must be regime-robust; LOYO check); 55d choice is a DoF — frozen at proposal time, no scan.

candidates.name: round_number_major_level_behavior
candidates.mechanism: Osler (2003, J. Finance): with real order data, take-profit limit orders cluster AT round numbers, stop-loss orders cluster just BEYOND them. Prediction 1: approaches to major round numbers reverse more than chance (limit cluster). Prediction 2: confirmed breaches accelerate (stop cascade). Institutional/real-money mechanism with published order-flow evidence — the only candidate whose level generation owes nothing to swing/price-action geometry.

proposed_frozen_definition.level: major round numbers only: integer 00 levels for JPY crosses (e.g., 150.00, 151.00), 100-pip 00 levels for USD-quoted pairs (e.g., 1.1000, 1.1100). No 50-levels in primary (fewer, cleaner events; 50-levels = declared non-tested, not a variant to scan).
proposed_frozen_definition.event: first D1 touch of a given round number after >=20 trading days without touching it ('fresh approach'). Touch = D1 high/low crosses the level. Direction hypothesis (PRIMARY, one-sided): reversal — forward return moves away from the level relative to approach direction.
proposed_frozen_definition.dedup: per level per 20 trading days by construction.
proposed_frozen_definition.pairs: USD_JPY, EUR_JPY, AUD_JPY, EUR_USD, GBP_USD, AUD_USD (6)

candidates.expected_frequency: fresh approaches to major levels: ~6-15/pair/year estimate; to be asserted.
candidates.headroom_estimate: 3d holds: typical |move| 30-80p vs RT 2.0-4.5p -> nominal ~10-25x; event-conditional confirmation required pre-look.
candidates.prior: medium: published mechanism (Osler) but published-anomaly decay ~50% (McLean-Pontiff) and FX-intraday evidence base; D1 multi-day version is in-repo untested.
candidates.banned_adjacency_and_differential: Round numbers are horizontal levels — the 3/3 dead lineage warning from catalog ny-cut entry applies. Differential: (1) exogenous level generation (no swing detection at all — corpses (i)/(iii) were swing/recent-extreme levels); (2) D1 events + multi-day holds (corpses were ×15m); (3) low-frequency 'fresh approach' conditioning (not continuous). vs ny-cut-pin-release: no expiry clock, D1 horizon — different estimand, and that entry was never measured (triage headroom fail on +1h/+4h horizons; our multi-day horizons change the headroom math). vs rnb_usdjpy shadow: that is a live-forward USD_JPY data track with no historical claim; this explore is historical and measurement-only — reconciliation statement to be included in pre-reg (no duplication of live collection, results feed that track's design).

Level-density differs by pair regime (fast trends touch many levels: 'fresh approach' filter handles).

candidates.name: anchored_vwap_deviation_reversion
candidates.mechanism: Anchored VWAP from institutional anchor dates (year start / quarter start) is a benchmark for institutional execution; extreme deviation implies benchmark-chasing rebalance pressure back toward the anchor line. In-repo untested.

proposed_frozen_definition.anchor: quarter start (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct first trading day), D1 bars.
proposed_frozen_definition.signal: deviation of close from anchored VWAP in ATR(20,D1) units; event = |dev| crosses 3.0 ATR for first time in that quarter; direction = reversion toward AVWAP.

candidates.expected_frequency: ~2-4 events/pair/year (thin; power concern to be asserted).
candidates.headroom_estimate: 5-10d reversion from 3-ATR extremes: nominal 10x+ plausible but unverified.
candidates.prior: low-medium: practitioner-popular, thin academic FX evidence.
candidates.banned_adjacency_and_differential: HONEST FLAGS FOR VERIFIER: (1) VWAP requires volume; FX spot has only tick volume — E2 verdict 'tick volume は弱 proxy' and E13 ban are adjacent; the institutional-benchmark mechanism is diluted under tick-volume weighting (TV FX volume = feed tick count). E12 P-10 letter does not cover it (CME volume only) but spirit-adjacency should be ruled on. (2) Without meaningful volume weighting AVWAP degenerates toward an anchored average price -> deviation-reversion becomes slow mean-reversion, adjacent to ppp FAIL type ('direction right but weak') and D1 channel-reversion family. Orchestrator expects KILL or heavy conditions; included for completeness of the parallel-line side.
candidates.known_risks: as above; also quarter-anchored events are calendar-clustered (bootstrap blocking).

candidates.name: d1_diagonal_trendline_sweep
candidates.mechanism: Sweep (wick-penetration + close-back) of a D1-scale diagonal trendline drawn from D1 swing points — the structure of trendline_sweep (the only line-based strategy that ever showed live WR80%) lifted from 15m to D1 anchors with multi-day holds.

proposed_frozen_definition.event: D1 bar penetrates line intraday (low < line for up-line) but closes back on the original side; direction = with-line (long at up-line sweep).
